inlines.v: DRUDGE, verb intransitive druj. To work hard; to labor in mean offices; to labor with toil and fatigue. In merriment did drudge and labor. DRUDGE, noun One who works hard, or labors with toil and fatigue; one who labors hard in servile employments; a slave.
